corinthians2.1.p1.b2.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

corinthians2.1.p1.b3.text: To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:

corinthians2.1.p1.b4.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

corinthians2.1.p2.b1.text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

corinthians2.1.p2.b2.text: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

corinthians2.1.p2.b3.text: … because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you will share in our comfort.

corinthians2.1.p3.b1.text: We do not want you to be unaware, brothers, of the hardships we encountered in the province of Asia. We were under a burden far beyond our ability to endure, so that we despaired even of life.

corinthians2.1.p3.b2.text: Indeed, we felt we were under the sentence of death, in order that we would not trust in ourselves, but in God, who raises the dead.

corinthians2.1.p3.b3.text: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf …

corinthians2.1.p4.b1.text: And this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, … not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.

corinthians2.1.p4.b2.text: For we do not write you anything that is beyond your ability to read and understand. …

corinthians2.1.p4.b3.text: … so that you may boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of our Lord Jesus.

corinthians2.1.p5.b1.text: Confident of this, I planned to visit you first, so that you might receive a double blessing.

corinthians2.1.p5.b2.text: When I planned this, did I do it carelessly?

corinthians2.1.p5.b3.text: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not “Yes” and “No.”

corinthians2.1.p5.b4.text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was proclaimed among you by me and Silvanus and Timothy, … in Him it has always been “Yes.”

corinthians2.1.p6.b1.text: For all the promises of God are “Yes” in Christ. …

corinthians2.1.p6.b2.text: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come.

corinthians2.1.p6.b3.text: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

corinthians2.1.p6.b4.text: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we are fellow workers with you for your joy, because it is by faith that you stand firm.
